# Deployment Pipeline & Operations Requirements Quality Checklist: AWS Deployment for MisiOps

**Purpose**: Unit-test the requirements for the trigger chain (DevSecOps → deploy), environment mapping, approval, concurrency, artifact reuse, rollback, verification, observability, infrastructure testing and documentation
**Created**: 2026-11-07 | **Reviewed**: 2026-11-08 (reviewer: repository team; gaps closed in spec.md, research.md and contracts/deploy-workflow.md the same day)
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Trigger Chain & Environment Mapping

- [x] CHK001 Are the exact trigger conditions enumerated (source workflow, completion event, branches, `conclusion`, originating event is push) and is every other combination explicitly a no-op? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, Contracts deploy-workflow]
- [x] CHK002 Is the meaning of "completed successfully" distinguished for `develop` (report-only gates, pipeline finished) and `main` (every gate passed), so the same condition is not read as a security guarantee on `develop`? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, Research §R11]
- [x] CHK003 Is the branch-to-environment mapping closed (`develop`→`dev`, `main`→`prod`, anything else → skip) and is the skip outcome recorded visibly? [Completeness, Data Model §Deployment]
- [x] CHK004 Is the behaviour specified when the DevSecOps run was manually dispatched (`workflow_dispatch`) or re-run on an old commit? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK005 Is it specified which commit the deploy checks out (the pipeline run's head SHA, not the branch tip) so a later push cannot change what is deployed? [Clarity, Contracts deploy-workflow]
- [x] CHK006 Are the `infra/`-only changes covered: does a push that changes infrastructure but no application code still go through the DevSecOps build and deploy chain, and is that intended? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Approval & Concurrency

- [x] CHK007 Is the production approval expressed as a requirement on the mechanism (environment protection rule, named reviewers) and its record (approver login retained)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, Data Model §Deployment]
- [x] CHK008 Is the timeout of a pending production approval defined (expires, stays pending, superseded by a newer run)? [Gap, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK009 Is "a newer deployment supersedes a queued older one" consistent with "in-flight deployments finish", and is the superseded outcome observable? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015, Research §R11]
- [x] CHK010 Is the interaction between a `dev` deployment and a simultaneous `prod` deployment specified (independent groups, no shared lock)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK011 Is the idempotency requirement precise about what "nothing changes" means (same digest pushed to an immutable tag, stack reports no changes, smoke test still runs)? [Measurability, Spec §Edge Cases, Contracts deploy-workflow]

## Artifact Reuse & Registry

- [x] CHK012 Is the artifact contract (name, files, retention, origin run) stated as a dependency on the existing DevSecOps workflow, and is the consequence of changing it in that workflow addressed? [Dependency, Spec §FR-009, Research §R11]
- [x] CHK013 Is the failure mode "artifact expired or missing" specified with its visible result and the operator's recovery step (re-run DevSecOps, never rebuild)? [Exception Flow, Spec §FR-009, Research §R11]
- [x] CHK014 Is the tag scheme (full commit SHA, immutable) and the behaviour on pushing an already-present tag with identical or different content specified? [Clarity, Research §R10, Contracts deploy-workflow]
- [x] CHK015 Is the GHCR publication by the existing `deliver` job explicitly kept or retired, so two registries do not drift silently? [Consistency, Spec §NFR-006, Research §R10]

## Rollback & Verification

- [x] CHK016 Is "does not become healthy" defined (health-check path, status code, failure count, time window) so the rollback trigger is measurable? [Measurability, Spec §FR-013, Contracts cdk-stacks]
- [x] CHK017 Is the rollback requirement complete for infrastructure changes that fail after the services updated (stack rollback), not only for unhealthy tasks? [Coverage, Spec §FR-013, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK018 Is "no full outage" quantified (zero failed external probes at a stated interval during the deployment) in both the requirement and the success criterion? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, §SC-004]
- [x] CHK019 Are the post-deployment checks enumerated with expected responses, and is the backend check path chosen one that is routed to the API at the public address? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017, Research §R15]
- [x] CHK020 Is the responsiveness target method-defined (sample size, sequential vs. parallel, measured from where) so NFR-009 and SC-009 agree? [Measurability, Spec §NFR-009, §SC-009]
- [x] CHK021 Is a manual rollback procedure required in the documentation (redeploy previous SHA) and does it state that it uses the same workflow path, not a console action? [Gap, Spec §FR-019]
- [x] CHK022 Is the behaviour defined when the smoke test fails after a successful stack update (environment left on the new version but run red) and is that acceptable? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-017]

## Observability

- [x] CHK023 Are log group naming, retention and the "tagged with environment and service" requirement specified so the US6 scenario can be judged? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016, US6]
- [x] CHK024 Is the one-minute log visibility target measured from request time to availability in the central view, and is it a requirement or only a scenario? [Clarity, Spec US6 scenario 1]
- [x] CHK025 Is it stated what the deployment run must record (environment, commit, digests, public address, approver) so a Deployment can be audited later? [Completeness, Data Model §Deployment, Contracts deploy-workflow]
- [x] CHK026 Are the metrics and alerting explicitly out of scope, and is a minimal signal for "the environment is down" (health-check alarm) consciously excluded or missing? [Gap, Spec §Out of Scope]

## Infrastructure Code Quality & Tests

- [x] CHK027 Are the security properties that infrastructure tests must assert enumerated as requirements (not only in research) and mapped to FR/NFR identifiers? [Traceability, Spec §NFR-007, Research §R12]
- [x] CHK028 Is the synth-without-credentials requirement explicit about which values CI needs (account, region, context file) and that lookups must be committed? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, Research §R12]
- [x] CHK029 Is the topology-parity rule (FR-002) made checkable (same constructs, only parameters differ) and is the list of allowed per-environment differences closed? [Measurability, Spec §FR-002, Data Model §Environment]
- [x] CHK030 Is the structure requirement (`infra/` top-level) reflected in every place that enumerates implementation code (SDD enforcer, pre-push hook, AGENTS.md, constitution tree)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, Research §R16]
- [x] CHK031 Are the two application changes (build argument default, runtime label) covered by test requirements, and is the Compose build argument requirement stated so local behaviour is verifiable? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004, Plan §Project Structure]
- [x] CHK032 Are all new third-party actions and libraries listed with versions in one place that `tasks.md` can cite? [Completeness, Spec §NFR-005, Plan §Technical Context]

## Documentation & Onboarding

- [x] CHK033 Does the runbook requirement enumerate every section (bootstrap, identity federation, variables, environments, required checks, first deploy, approve `prod`, manual rollback, logs, teardown) rather than "describe the flow"? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019, Quickstart]
- [x] CHK034 Is the 60-minute onboarding criterion scoped (which steps count, which prerequisites are assumed installed)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [x] CHK035 Is the decision not to deploy `prod` in this feature, and the exact command that later creates it, recorded where a future operator will look? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, Quickstart §9]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Items marked `[Gap]` that the reviewer confirms should become spec or plan text before `/speckit-tasks`
